fusions.name: Pickpocket Sip
fusions.desc: Sends a bite at the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Decoy Scatter
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 12 damage and is knocked back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 40% chance to turn the target against its allies for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Vanishing Trick
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Fortune's Favour
fusions.desc: When you go without a critical hit for a while, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
